mapper.sql: u.id AS id, u.login_name AS loginName, u.display_name AS displayName, u.status AS status, u.version AS version, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, un.unit_code AS unitCode, un.unit_name AS unitName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id) AS aggregatedRoleCodes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id) AS aggregatedRoleNames

where.if: AND un.unit_code = CONVERT(#{q.unitCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = CONVERT(#{q.roleCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (login_name, display_name, password_hash, unit_id) VALUES (#{loginName}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, (SELECT id FROM sys_unit WHERE unit_code = CONVERT(#{unitCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, unit_id = (SELECT id FROM sys_unit WHERE unit_code = CONVERT(#{unitCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
